description.value: BarBurrito is Canada's largest burrito chain, proudly Canadian since 2005 and now operating 385+ locations nationwide. This Abbotsford Village location serves fully customizable Mexican-inspired meals — burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas — made to order from fresh in-house ingredients. It's a convenient fast-casual stop for cyclists moving through Abbotsford along the Sumas Way corridor.
